# requires: logging
#
# These lines are the interface between programs that were not built together,
# so the version is checked on read rather than inferred from the fields that
# happen to parse. A reader meeting a schema it does not understand has no way
# to know which of the fields it recognises still mean what they meant, and a
# newer writer must not be silently misread by an older reader.
#
# Zero is here because it is the value a record acquires when a writer forgot to
# set the field, and a reader that treats absent as "the version I know" has
# turned the check off for exactly the writer most likely to be wrong.
decode 1
decode 2
decode 0

# expect 1: ok [LOG-R2]
# expect 2: refused schema=2 [LOG-R2]
# expect 3: refused schema=0 [LOG-R2]
